QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Moment's Rest
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've moved your bed near the window, why not have a little lie down and see if you like its new spot? Stand near the bed and #bclick#k it to use it!
QuestInfo.1: To lie down on your bed, stand next to it and\n#bclick#k it.
QuestInfo.2:
As you lay there on the bed, for the first very time you realized you were home

Alvin said he had a little gift for you. Why not enjoy your new bed a bit longer while he goes to get it?
